title: Fun evening
text: We had a lovely evening sampling tapas dishes and accompanying drinks across the town. Rosie our guide was everything you would want in a host, hospitable and knowledgeable. We had a great group which helped and we stuck around a bit longer for a chat when it ended.
author: Danmer23

title: First night Tapas tour
text:
Booked as a first night activity in Seville and we were glad we did. 
It’s generally not the kind of thing we do. 
Anna our guide was fantastic. Very knowledgeable and very enthusiastic. 
We were taken around side streets that were far from the main tourist areas and taken to bars that we would likely have walked straight past. 
There was plenty of great tapas offered with a drink at each of the four stops, Anna given background information and recommendations as we when. 
All in all I thought it was great value 
for money and certainly recommend it.
author: siwni

title: Wow.  Just wow.
text: A brilliant night.  Our guide Ferran arranged a variety of historically significant and tasty tapas paired with traditional drinks.  Every location was different and wonderful.   Cannot recommend this tour enough.   If you’re lucky enough to have Ferran as your host, it will be amazing.
author: Connector19781647236

title: Away from the tourist crowds
text:
I had a lovely time on this tapas crawl. Ferran was a great guide, taking us away from the tourist crowds and into genuinely authentic local spots.

The food and drink pairings were delicious, and Ferran’s local knowledge made the whole night feel relaxed and fun.
author: dahlia736

title: Great food tapas tour with ferran
text: Ferran was very knowledgeable friendly and made us all feel very welcome.  We would highly recommend these tours where you can not only eat delicious food but learn about its history.  We enjoyed specifically local food and drinks.  Thank you Fernan
author: Fdavidmercer

title: Great food tour, highly recommended
text: Ferran was a great host, extremely knowledgeable and interesting & we had a great evening. Fabulous tapas, great pairing drinks & we visited places we would never have found ourselves. Highly recommended!

title: Fun tapas tour

title: Best food tour in Seville
text: Colin was a great tour guide. He took us off the usual tourist tracks. We tasted a lot of local specialties and we would recommend taking this tour at the start of your vacation in Seville to get to know what locals eat and drink.
